stance_rationale: weights.csv is a real multi-date schedule and basic name/bound/sum/liquidity/cost checks mostly pass, but the optimizer handoff is not admissible because target_weights are not aligned to the supplied alpha/risk handoff and the selected method breaches the CVaR cap. The package also lacks optimizer Charter 8 evidence and contains inconsistent infeasibility logic.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: HRP_Quarterly is highest net_IR among turnover-passing candidates, but every candidate fails pass_cvar_cap.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: 3.95 * 0.0015 * 2 = 0.01185, matching the rounded 15bps round-trip cost. Gross L1 schedule turnover annualizes near 7.83, consistent with one-way turnover near 3.91.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: 80/20 design is reported, but tdc_vs_pg2 is only an Iter 3 cross-section Jaccard proxy and blended SR/MDD/IR are TBD.

critical_concerns.description: At 2023-12-01, target_weights hold 8 risk names, but only 2 overlap the supplied covariance.parquet 20-name risk handoff; 70.87% of risk weight is in tickers absent from the provided Σ, so the target cannot be audited as a pure Optimizer function of Risk's covariance artifact.

Selected HRP_Quarterly has cvar95_daily_proxy=0.0260 versus the 0.025 cap, and all 10 candidates have pass_cvar_cap=false; an infeasibility report is necessary but does not make breached target_weights admissible.

At the final signal date, 18 of the current top-20 alpha names receive zero weight and 70.87% of risk weight is allocated outside the same-date alpha top 20; across the schedule, 1205 risk rows are rank>20 by same-date score_eff.

Alpha has RF-A1 subperiod stability failure at 0.0598, but the selected method has confidence_used=false; testing confidence-aware MVO as an unselected candidate does not address the final weight construction.

The package claims pooled fallback for CRISIS/CAUTION, but 7 of 24 CAUTION dates use held_lw_oracle rather than pooled fallback, while 10 NORMAL dates carry held pooled-fallback labels from prior regimes.

request.json specifies rebalance_frequency=monthly, but the selected implementation is HRP_Quarterly; this may be defensible for turnover, but without optimizer_challenge_note it is a silent process override.

optimizer_challenge_note.md is absent, artifact_lineage.json has alpha and risk entries only, and the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260425_010 path is absent; optimizer AX-008 triangulation is incomplete.
Direct TDC versus MEGA_05/PG2 is not measured, replacement and 80/20 integration have no blended SR/MDD/IR, and the core admission test is deferred to Forge.

The infeasibility report says all 10 candidates exceed the turnover cap, but HRP_Quarterly turnover is 3.95 and four candidates pass pass_to_cap; the 20% integration note also cites 762% turnover rather than the selected 395%.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv has 216 as_of_dates from 2006-01-01 to 2023-12-01 and is not a single-snapshot artifact.
Per-date weight sums pass with max absolute error about 2.1e-15; max risk names=20, max risk weight=0.20, and all risk weights are non-negative.
Liquidity/universe spot audit passed for all 3540 risk rows: every weighted ticker is KOSPI200 or KOSDAQ150 and lagged AvgTV20 minimum is about 204.17m KRW.
alpha_scores.parquet is a proper time-series panel with 240 signal dates, 70,065 rows, 773 tickers, and Date x Ticker x score columns.
covariance.parquet is symmetric PSD with min eigenvalue 0.003300942 and condition number 24.3401; pooled fallback is PSD with condition number 100.
Cash overlay percentages match regime labels on all 216 dates, and all CRISIS dates use pooled fallback.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Optimizer is allowed to re-estimate per-date Σ inside run_optimizer_iter5.R instead of consuming Risk-owned covariance artifacts as a pure function.
Whether quarterly held weights satisfy the base walk-forward promise and the task-specific monthly rebalance request.
Whether a CVaR-passing portfolio exists under semiannual rebalance, explicit CVaR optimization, HRP+DD brake, no-trade bands, or ADV pacing.
Whether monthly-return CVaR divided by sqrt(21) is sufficient for a daily CVaR cap, or daily realized portfolio returns are required.
Whether direct PG2 NAV or active-book data can be made available for real TDC and 80/20 admission metrics.
Whether final target_weights should be regenerated from the 2023-12 alpha_vector and supplied 2023-12 covariance.parquet.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that HRP_Quarterly target_weights are a valid implementation of the 2023-12 alpha/risk handoff despite allocating 70.87% of risk weight to names absent from the supplied covariance.parquet and breaching the CVaR cap.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate target_weights using the exact 2023-12 alpha_vector and risk_package covariance artifact, or provide optimizer lineage for every per-date Σ re-estimation.
Rerun selection with admissibility requiring both turnover_pass and cvar_pass, or mark the optimizer result formally infeasible without actionable target_weights.
Explain why 18 of the current top-20 alpha names receive zero weight and why rank>20 held names are acceptable under RF-O1 and L-484.
Use confidence-aware MVO, BL prior shrinkage, or an explicit confidence penalty in the selected method, not only as a failed candidate.
Fix CAUTION/NORMAL fallback labeling and enforcement so regime-conditional Σ use matches the package claim.
Add optimizer_challenge_note.md and append optimizer_package/weights/covariance hashes to artifact_lineage.json.
Provide direct PG2 TDC and replacement plus 80/20 blended SR/MDD/IR.

TDC vs PG2 to be computed at Forge backtest stage

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: B-stage artifacts are measurable, but optimizer-specific triangulation is incomplete: no optimizer challenge note, no optimizer lineage entry, no direct PG2 admission evidence, and no Forge/Architect pass.

optimizer_specific_questions: Can this weights schedule be applied as a 22-year walk-forward schedule if quarterly held months are allowed to diverge from same-date top alpha names?
Why is the final target accepted when only 2 of 8 risk names overlap the current Risk covariance artifact?
Can any candidate satisfy both turnover <600% and cvar95_daily_proxy <=2.5%, or is this optimizer handoff formally infeasible?
Is the reported TDC a cross-section proxy or a true time-series realized correlation versus MEGA_05/PG2?
Where is the optimizer_challenge_note.md required by Charter 8?
